annotations.title: Conclude your part of the stage

description: Finish or waive your part of the current stage: for example after presenting evidence, to waive an opening statement, or, as judge, to proceed without questions. Needs your API key.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.
